label: Other religion
note: 2020-21 only. The coded scheme (item_group=2) stops at 10=Jain and has no 'other religion' member, so there is no item_id to map this to. Left unmapped rather than invented.

label: Students with Aadhaar
note: 2020-21 only. Not an enrolment breakdown at all — a count of students holding an Aadhaar number. No coded equivalent in any later edition; do not add it to a social-category or religion total.

label: CWSN (total; disability type not broken out)
note: 2020-21 publishes ONE total for children with special needs. From 2022-23 the same concept is broken out into item_group=4's 20 disability types. Comparing 2020-21 to a later year means summing item_group=4 across all item_ids in the later year — never comparing this row to a single disability type.

NOT A REAL VALUE — documents what an EMPTY item_desc means, and it is deliberately left unmapped. 182,426 of the 1,509,136 schools in 2020-21 (12%) carry one extra enrolment row whose item_desc is empty, positioned right after BPL. Investigated: it is NOT a total (it never exceeds the school's General+SC+ST+OBC sum), NOT a duplicate of BPL or Aadhar, and NOT EWS-shaped (75% of the schools carrying it are management=1, Dept. of Education, where the RTE/EWS quota does not apply). It is a genuine subgroup worth ~8.9% of enrolment in the schools that report it. No codebook names it. It stays unmapped rather than guessed; the rows are still in the fact with item_dimension NULL and item_source_label NULL, so they can be found and excluded.

label: Under 5
note: 2020-21 age rows carry a readable label. From 2022-23 the same cut is published as item_group=8 with an opaque `item_id` the codebook describes only as 'Age id (2 to 22)' — no id-to-age table is published, so ages are NOT comparable across the 2020-21 boundary.
